brand.name: Hiscope Construction
brand.tone: Bold, confident, premium, architectural, and industrial. No generic corporate slop. Emphasize scale, structure, and reliability.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none
rules.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento grids with gap-8 to gap-12, exposed grid lines (border-collapse style) for feature sections.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Unconventional asymmetrical positioning. Heavy left-alignment.

ui_components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). High contrast. Primary: bg-[#FF4500] text-white hover:bg-[#18181B]. Secondary: border-2 border-[#18181B] text-[#09090B] hover:bg-[#18181B] hover:text-white. Use data-testid on all.
ui_components.cards: Flat solid background, 1px solid border (#D4D4D8). No soft drop shadows. Sharp, technical aesthetic.
ui_components.navigation: Sticky, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px border-b border-[#D4D4D8]. Navigation links MUST be visible on desktop. Include CTA button.
ui_components.footer: Massive py-32. Dark mode footer (bg-[#09090B] text-white) to contrast the light theme body. Giant 'HISCOPE' text logo at the bottom spanning full width.

visual_enhancements.textures: Use concrete textures as subtle background layers in key sections with low opacity.
visual_enhancements.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a 'Kinetic Texture' of 'HISCOPE CONSTRUCTION' repeated in a massive outline font behind main sections.
visual_enhancements.animations: Framer Motion for staggered list entrances. Reveal animations on scroll. Hover: slight negative Y translation and stark black block shadow.

pages.home: Hero section with background image and massive 'BUILDING THE IMPOSSIBLE' text overlay. Stats bar below hero using exposed grid layout. Services preview bento grid. Project showcase carousel. Call to action.
pages.about_us: Split layout: left side large typography 'OUR STORY', right side paragraphs. Core values displayed in brutalist grid with icons. Team section with monochrome portraits.
pages.services: Grid of services: Residential, Commercial, Industrial. Each card has a hover effect that reveals an image or changes background to safety orange.
pages.projects: Filterable gallery. Filters: All, Commercial, Industrial, Residential. Grid layout with images having max-h constraints and object-cover.
pages.careers: Header with 'JOIN THE BUILD'. Static list of open roles mapped over an array. Each role is an accordion or a row that expands to show requirements.
pages.contact_us: Left column: Contact info (Address, Phone, Email) in large typography. Right column: Form using Shadcn primitives (Input, Textarea, Button). Do not use HTML inputs. Add mailto action for form submission.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add 'Chivo' and 'IBM Plex Sans' via Google Fonts to index.html or global css.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the selected fonts and colors.
Create a layout wrapper with the sticky header and dark footer.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections (hero, bento grids) instead of rigid Shadcn cards.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily customized for interactives (Forms, Inputs, Accordion for Careers).
Follow the generous spacing rule: use p-8, p-12, or p-24 for padding.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and form elements.
Avoid generic placeholders; use the media URLs provided in this file.
The UI should feel raw, architectural, and bold—not like a typical SaaS dashboard.
